|translation='''Title:''' General Carlist Rieekan.

'''Card text:'''
Each Rebel at the same Hoth location is power +1. May use 1 Force to cancel Death Squadron. While at an Echo site, the opponent must occupy one extra Hoth site to cancel Echo Base Operations.

'''Lore:'''
One of the founders of the Rebel Alliance. A former civilian tactician who advised the House of Organa. The leader of Echo Base, who warns against optimism.
